sources.title: shaishaicookie.github.io - Sherry Wang
sources.snippet: So, I created one! I developed a macOS app that provides auto captions for FCP powered by Open AI's Whisper model. During that time, I also tried CapCut's video background removal feature - Auto cutout. Compared to Adobe After Effects' Rotobrush at that time, its cutout was extremely precise.

sources.title: Whisper Captions for After Effects - GitHub
sources.snippet: Whisper Captions for After Effects Transcribe audio and generate timed caption text layers directly inside After Effects, using faster-whisper running 100% locally — no cloud, no API keys. Full Hebrew (עברית) support: RTL captions, Hebrew UI preview, and the ivrit.ai Hebrew-tuned Whisper model built into the model picker.

sources.snippet: Model Description This model is a fine-tuned version of openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo (809M parameters) trained for audio captioning — generating natural language descriptions of audio content rather than transcription.
